title: Verify the full declared European mode-7 streams
platforms: European ROM, Windows CLI via Wine
changes: Follow every declared E301 type-4 tilemap row and establish the complete reader-derived bounds of the two mode-7 streams.
validation: Wine x6mub2vs authenticates the original helper. Wine u8bkowmo checks 34 rows and ten type-4 descriptor paths, verifies E301 ownership of all 20 mode-7 source bytes and leaves the two-byte Soil gap outside that extent. Both Wine servers drained.
limitations: Additional roots, other readers and scenes, the purpose of the Soil gap, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No gameplay replay or performance comparison was made.
